parsed.post: Significant improvement in val_bpb (0.941 -> 0.908) by increasing DEPTH from 4 to 6. The model is scaling well. Next, I will try increasing ASPECT_RATIO to expand the context/receptive field while keeping the depth constant to see if it yields better density.
parsed.description: Increase ASPECT_RATIO to 64 to expand the receptive field/context length and see if it improves compression efficiency.
